lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-uniform grid pattern with increasing inter-blob distance towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly higher pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, with the largest and most distinct blobs located at these intersection points, creating a primary lattice structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; the most prominent displays a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral) running from the post-branchial region to the base of the second dorsal fin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated along the lower half of the fin's trailing edge and base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple elongated, high-luminance vermiform features attached to the ventral-lateral surface near the pectoral fin and pelvic region, consistent with the visual signature of trailing ectoparasites or remoras.
